reasons: The three images successfully fulfill their distinct editorial roles: image 1 provides a wide overview of the crop identity within the field, image 2 offers an agronomic close-up focusing on the soil and plant health, and image 3 presents a compelling irrigation-system narrative with a farm-wide context (tractor and plowed field).
The visual variety in camera angles, framing, and lighting ensures the images do not feel repetitive despite the consistent presence of the same crop (Rosemary) and the same AFP product brand.
Zero people appear in any of the images, and the crop morphology is consistent throughout the set.
